# NDDev Figma library — data

`variables.json` is the library file "NDDev Design System" as data; the file is built from it and never edited by hand.

| Collection | Modes | Holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primitives | Value | foundation: space, rhythm, radius, sizes, borders, opacity, leading, tracking, weights, layout |
| Theme | Light, Dark, Light contrast, Dark contrast | every theme role; `accent/*` and other direction-dependent roles alias the Direction collection |
| Direction | OpenNetwork | hidden per-theme entries (`<theme>/accent/text`) the Theme collection aliases |
| Platform | Web, Desktop, iOS, Android | type sizes, font families, hidden per-density control sizes |
| Density | Comfortable, Compact | control and target sizes (aliases into Platform) |
| Motion | Standard, Reduced | durations (ms) |
| Component | Value | UI kit roles aliasing semantic and foundation tokens |

A frame picks one mode per collection; theme and direction (and platform and density) compose like the token resolver. Colours are the values native code draws (modifiers applied). Opacity variables are percentages (0-100), the scale Figma applies to layer opacity; the tokens and CSS are 0-1. Effect styles bind each shadow layer to Theme variables; text styles bind family, size and weight to variables and carry leading and tracking as percentages. Web-only values (breakpoints, layered gradients, z-index, springs) stay in code.
